dedupe_keys.name: six indian cement plants primary material electricity and emissions inventories

description: This deposit provides primary life-cycle inventories for four integrated cement plants and two grinding units across Indian cement-producing regions. The IIT Madras team collects plant questionnaires, site observations, fuel analyses and transport information to quantify materials, electricity, energy use and carbon emissions. An Excel workbook separates inventories and characterization factors, captive-power production per kilowatt-hour, and product impacts per tonne. Two Word questionnaires accompany it, all free under CC BY 4.0 on Mendeley version 2. Values are average annual plant information, but the repository does not give a common reference year. Six cases do not establish national averages, and different system boundaries must be preserved when comparing products. A reviewer-assessed use is preparing cement supply-chain or infrastructure-material transition simulations. data-annual-global-cement-production-andrew gives related aggregate production totals, at a different scale. No workbook formulas, impact calculations or questionnaire responses were independently checked.
